items.source: Can be used natively, declaring several nested JmsListener annotations. Can also be used in conjunction with Java's support for repeatable annotations, where JmsListener can simply be declared several times on the same method, implicitly generating this container annotation.
items.translation: 可以原生使用，声明多个嵌套的JmsListener注解。也可以与 Java 对可重复注解的支持结合使用，在这种情况下，只需在同一方法上多次声明JmsListener，即可隐式生成该容器注解。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。
